You will be nothing more than a lost soul-..!|[[Swamp Monster (Narrator)|Swamp Monster]] dialogue on Wave 12 ([[Foggy Forest]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Swamp Monster''' was the final boss of the second night in the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a large amount of health for its appearance and a very slow speed. When using its ''Trident Throw'' ability, it would stop moving and threw four tridents at towers, stunning them. It was immune to being frozen and slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. Additionally, the [[Electroshocker]] could only slow it down instead of stunning it. ==Appearance== The '''Swamp Monster''' had dark green and green skin. It was faceless but had two large yellow eyes on its torso and one on its left arm, and two large yellow eyes on its back and the back of its left arm. It had four dark green tentacles, all of which held a blue glowing trident, which it used to stun towers. ==Strategy== *Use high DPS towers, such as the [[Swarmer]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] to defeat this. **While it may look like the [[Accelerator]] does not attack the '''Swamp Monster''', it is only a visual bug. The [[Accelerator]] does deal damage to it. *The [[Commander]] is recommended to boost the firerate of the towers. *The ''Trident Throw'' ability will make the '''Swamp Monster''' stop moving for a long period of time, you can use this to your advantage to deal as much damage as possible. **While the ''Trident Throw'' ability cannot directly target [[units]], it can still damage them. *Because of its immunities, it can only be slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]]. **However, because of its [[Energy Immunity]], it could only be slowed down instead of completely stopped. Its large size also reduced the [[Electroshocker]]'s shock time. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Night2Icon.png|'''Swamp Monster''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NightIIPI.jpg|'''Swamp Monster''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Swamp Monster''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Swamp Monster''' is very similar to the [[Swamp Thing]] from the [[Nightmare Carnival]]. *The '''Swamp Monster's''' theme uses the old [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hvcihildZqs You Lost!] theme as a leitmotif. *Interestingly, the '''Swamp Monster''' was seen in [[Tower Outskirts]] in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x_v0MXniUSM Solar Eclipse Trailer] despite it never appearing there. ==Update History== *'''6 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]b **'''Swamp Monster''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Swamp Monster''' removed. {{FoggyForest|[[Werewolf (Solar Eclipse)|Werewolf]]|Wave 11|Swamp Monster|Wave 12|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
